entries.title: A crewmate can do more on a web page
entries.body: In a task's browser, a crewmate can now point at a menu to open it, fill in many fields at once, drag something from one place to another, jump to the top or bottom of a page, and take a picture of one part of a page. It still does none of this while you have control.
entries.noPicture: The change is in what a crewmate can do on a page; no view of the app changed.
